Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) Stock Rose While Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management LP Has Raised Its Stake; As Intl Business Machines (IBM) Stock Declined, Stonebridge Capital Advisors Boosted Stake by $2.56 Million
April 27, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Daniel Arbess increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 42.79% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management Lp bought 46,517 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Daniel Arbess held 155,224 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.18 million, up from 108,707 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.34 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.17% or $3.25 during the last trading session, reaching $105.74. About 5.03 million shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Intl Business Machines Corp (IBM) by 165.99% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc bought 16,705 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 26,769 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.11M, up from 10,064 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Intl Business Machines Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $134.89 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $146.43. About 2.24 million shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
